widgets.value:
### OAuth client
The values ported from agentic-workspace are the **Workspace MCP** *Desktop app* client in the `crispal` Google Cloud project. Desktop clients accept any `localhost` redirect, which is what this server's callback uses — a Web client would need its exact callback URL registered in Google Cloud first.

The secret is stored in the zero-knowledge secret store, never in plain config.

fields.label: OAuth client ID
fields.description: Not a credential on its own — also visible in this app's Settings.

fields.description: Leave blank to keep the secret already saved.

widgets.value:
### Authorizing a Google account
A saved OAuth client is not consent. Two ways to get a token:

1. **[Connect Google Account](/api/apps/google-workspace-mcp/oauth/start)** — opens in a new tab and starts a fresh Google consent flow for the configured account. The callback lands on this server's own `/oauth2callback`, so the browser completing it must be able to reach that port. Use this to (re)authorize, or to recover from an expired/revoked token — no agent needed.
2. **Import an existing one** — if this account was already authorized in agentic-workspace, copy its `<email>.json` from that host's `.tmp/google_workspace_mcp_credentials/` and POST it to `/api/apps/google-workspace-mcp/credentials` with `{"email": "…", "credentials": {…}}`. No consent screen, no browser.

Tokens live in `$AW_WORKSPACE_HOME/data/google-workspace-mcp/credentials/` and survive an app reinstall.

### Server
`workspace-mcp` runs in its own private venv — never the workspace's shared one, whose `starlette`/`cryptography`/`mcp` versions it would otherwise upgrade under every other Python MCP server. Reinstall it after changing `pin_version` in Settings.
